message: NO_TRADE: complete fresh 18-symbol Dukascopy H1 BID/ASK scan GDESK-2026-09-25T05-0e89dfe5cf found no genuinely qualified setup. Broad JPY strength persists across USDJPY, AUDJPY, CADJPY, CHFJPY, GBPJPY and EURJPY, but those moves are highly correlated and already extended into recent lows, so entering now would be chasing rather than taking clean asymmetry. USDCHF is pushing recent highs but lacks a clean pullback or breakout confirmation beyond the local 0.82935 area. EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD and NZDUSD are weak-to-mixed without a clean independent trigger; EURGBP is compressed; EURAUD, GBPAUD, EURCAD and GBPCAD are choppy after reversals. XAUUSD sold off sharply from the Asian rebound and remains too volatile for a clean 0.25%-0.5% risk entry from completed H1 bars. No trade is preferable to forcing correlated or late momentum exposure.
